notes.title: Demo Update! - Unlockable Costumes and General Improvements
notes.notes: A substantial update for WARRIOR SPIRIT's demo is now live! There are now unlockable colors for WARRIOR SPIRIT (The demo only features Red and Yellow- the rest are in the full game). You'll have to find them though. Also, other things like Aiming and Lock-On have been improved as well. Enjoy!

notes.title: NEW and Improved Demo!
notes.notes:
[h1]New Demo Features:
[/h1]

[list]
[*]New Playable Area: Blossom Castle
[*]Entirely New Level in Super Sponge Spire
[*]Gameplay Additions and Tweaks to the Wall-Running
[*]New Visual Effects
[*]Additional SFX
[*]General Additions and Improvements to the game all-around
[/list]

It has about double the content as the last demo. There are many new features and improvements. Whether you've played the last demo or this is your first time seeing WARRIOR SPIRIT, you should try it out!

notes.title: Full Keyboard and Mouse Support
notes.notes: There are now Keyboard and Mouse glyphs in the tutorial for WARRIOR SPIRIT. Also, various bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Update: Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes:
This update fixes various bugs and improves the game overall.

- Fixed miscellaneous bugs
- Improved Animation for Dash-Down / High-Jump
- Added small details to Cacti Caverns
- Tweaked several hit-boxes to improve gameplay experience
- Improved the tutorialization text
- Improved some of the game's Spanish localization

notes.title: UPDATE: Upgraded Graphics and new Accessibility Features
notes.notes:
Features and changes:

- Added a Keyboard + Mouse Controller Guide to the Pause Menu
- Added Color Blind Mode
- Improved the graphics of Calibration Course

notes.title: Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Play WARRIOR SPIRIT at Steam Next Fest - June 10-17. There is a free, playable demo that you can download right now on the WARRIOR SPIRIT store page!: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1188400/WARRIOR_SPIRIT/]Click Here to Download[/url] 

WARRIOR SPIRIT™ is a classic single-player 3D platformer adventure game for all ages.
Combine the four Arms of Good with a diverse set of clay materials to swing, bounce, wall-run and dash through the four corners of the land, each a giant area to explore. 

It's not just fun, but beautiful and unlike anything else. Explore these areas with unique and expressive momentum-based abilities.
